name: rehearse_flow
title: Rehearse a flow
description:
Play a flow as the customer on Send4's simulator. No real customer
is texted. To start: `flow_id` and `mode`: `inbound` (first message in `say`), `campaign` (list
columns in `context`), `webhook` (request body in `payload`) or `web_chat`. Works on drafts. To
reply: `conversation_id` and `say`. To fast-forward: `conversation_id` and `control` (`skip_wait`
ends a wait card's timer, `end_tail` closes the follow-up window). The AI takes a few seconds: read the answer with `read_rehearsal`. It spends the AI allowance, and webhook, email
and Hanna cards send for real, marked as tests.
